outcome: Need for a neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) stay
Length of stay in the NICU
Rate of transient tachypnea of the newborn
cohort: The study included women who gave birth between May 2018 and March 2021 at 34+0-36+6 weeks of gestation, assigned to groups based on whether they received antenatal steroids.
finding: Antenatal steroid administration significantly reduced various neonatal respiratory complications, including respiratory distress syndrome, and the need for NICU stay in late preterm births.
